<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }

<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }

<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }

<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }

<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }

<!doctype html><html lang="en-US"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high" href="https://khoros.ai/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/fonts/inter-6ab57b19.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin><link rel="profile" href="https://gmpg.org/xfn/11"><meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1' /> <script defer id="khoros-tracking" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script> <script>if(window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1025px)').matches){document.documentElement.classList.add('kh-lnav-on');}</script> <style id="kh-lnav-css">/* ==========================================================================
   Khoros Left Slide-in Nav  (built from Elementor header #408 at runtime)
   Active only when <html> has .kh-lnav-on (desktop >= 1025px).
   Remove the class / disable the snippet and the original top header returns.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --kh-lnav-rail: 80px;
  --kh-lnav-open: 300px;
  --kh-lnav-bg: #012F47;
  --kh-lnav-bg-2: #013853;
  --kh-lnav-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --kh-lnav-text: #ffffff;
  --kh-lnav-muted: #B8B8C8;
  --kh-lnav-accent: #CCE07D;
  --kh-lnav-top: var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height, 0px);
  --kh-lnav-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {

  /* ---- Swap: hide the top header, make room for the rail ---------------- */
  html.kh-lnav-on header.elementor-location-header { display: none !important; }
  html.kh-lnav-on body { padding-left: var(--kh-lnav-rail); }
  html.kh-lnav-on, html.kh-lnav-on body { overflow-x: clip; }

  /* ---- Rail / panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .kh-lnav {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--kh-lnav-top);
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 10020;
    width: var(--kh-lnav-rail);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font-family: "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), box-shadow .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open {
    width: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  }

  /* Brand: cropped to the Khoros mark when collapsed, full logo when open */
  .kh-lnav__brand {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin: 28px 0 0 13px;
    width: 54px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: width .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__brand { width: 170px; }
  .kh-lnav__brand img {
    display: block;
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  /* Reset theme/kit button styles on our controls */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__item,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    box-shadow: none;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* Edge tab (expand / collapse) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: -18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-top: -18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--kh-lnav-bg-2);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease);
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__tab:focus-visible { background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__tab { transform: rotate(180deg); background: var(--kh-lnav-accent); color: #013853; border-color: transparent; }
  .kh-lnav__tab svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* Body: nav list sits at the bottom like the GFI left nav */
  .kh-lnav__body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kh-lnav__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .32s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__list {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .25s .08s, transform .32s var(--kh-lnav-ease) .04s, visibility 0s;
  }

  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    font: 600 15px/1.3 "Poppins", "Roboto", sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .12);
    color: var(--kh-lnav-accent);
  }
  .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kh-lnav-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .kh-lnav__item svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .7; }

  /* Utilities: language + Support (moved from the header) */
  .kh-lnav__utils {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 14px 16px 0;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kh-lnav-line);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s, visibility 0s .32s;
  }
  .kh-lnav.is-open .kh-lnav__utils {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s .1s, visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav__utils > * { margin: 0 !important; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-widget-button { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .kh-lnav__utils .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  /* Weglot dropdown opens upward from the bottom of the panel.
     Specificity beats the site's own .kh-lnav-support ... > ul { inset: ... !important } rule. */
  .kh-lnav .kh-lnav__utils .kh-lnav-support .country-selector.weglot-dropdown > ul {
    inset: auto auto calc(100% + 6px) 0 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  /* Hamburger (collapsed state) */
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    margin-left: -22px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--kh-lnav-text);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: opacity .2s, background .2s;
  }
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); }
  .kh-lnav__burger svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav.is-open button.kh-lnav__burger { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---- Mega flyout --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-flyout {
    position: fixed;
    left: var(--kh-lnav-open);
    z-index: 10015;
    width: min(1160px, calc(100vw - var(--kh-lnav-open) - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--kh-lnav-top) - 32px);
    overflow: auto;
    margin-left: 16px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 22, 34, .45);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
    transition: opacity .18s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s var(--kh-lnav-ease), visibility 0s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane { display: none; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane.is-active { display: block; }

  /* Let the cloned Elementor mega content fill the flyout instead of 100vw/boxed width */
  .kh-lnav-flyout .e-con { --width: 100%; }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  .kh-lnav-flyout__pane > .elementor > .e-con > .e-con-inner { max-width: 100% !important; }

  /* ---- Light theme (white panel, color logo) ----------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] {
    --kh-lnav-bg: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-bg-2: #ffffff;
    --kh-lnav-line: rgba(1, 56, 83, .10);
    --kh-lnav-text: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"].is-open { box-shadow: 24px 0 60px rgba(0, 22, 34, .28); }
  /* Color logo file includes a tagline: show only the wordmark row */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand { height: 22px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__brand img { height: 33.57px; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item:focus-visible,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item[aria-expanded="true"] {
    background: rgba(204, 224, 125, .10);
    color: #013853;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav__item svg { color: var(--kh-lnav-accent); opacity: 1; }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:hover,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__burger:focus-visible { color: #013853; background: rgba(1, 56, 83, .06); }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] button.kh-lnav__tab { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 22, 34, .18); }
  /* Language switcher was styled for the dark header */
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent,
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent span {
    color: #013853 !important;
    border-color: rgba(1, 56, 83, .18) !important;
  }
  .kh-lnav[data-theme="light"] .kh-lnav-support .country-selector .wgcurrent::after { filter: invert(1) brightness(.3); }

  /* ---- Page dimmer --------------------------------------------------------- */
  .kh-lnav-scrim {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10010;
    background: rgba(0, 22, 34, .5);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s .25s;
  }
  .kh-lnav-scrim.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: opacity .25s, visibility 0s;
  }
}

/* Below desktop the original Elementor header (and its mobile menu) is used */
@media (max-width: 1024.98px) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kh-lnav, .kh-lnav *, .kh-lnav-flyout, .kh-lnav-scrim { transition: none !important; }
